confirmation.subject: Confirm your email to get started
confirmation.preheader: One more step and your account is ready.
confirmation.footer: You're getting this email because someone created a Genobills account with this address.
confirmation.heading: Confirm your email
confirmation.intro: Thanks for creating your account. Confirm this email is yours to start getting your finances in order.
confirmation.codeHint: Or type this code in the app:

recovery.subject: Your code to reset your password
recovery.preheader: Type this code in the app to create a new password.
recovery.footer: You're getting this email because a password reset was requested for your account.
recovery.heading: Reset your password
recovery.intro: We got a request to change the password for {{ .Email }}. Type this code in the app to create a new one:
recovery.codeCaption: Expires in 1 hour · can only be used once

email_change.subject: Confirm your new email
email_change.preheader: Confirm the change to start using your new email.
email_change.footer: You're getting this email because a change to your account's email was requested.
email_change.heading: Confirm your email change
email_change.intro: You asked to change the email you use to sign in to Genobills:
email_change.note: If you didn't ask for this change, don't confirm it and change your password from the app: your current email is still active.

password_changed.subject: Your password changed
password_changed.footer: This is a security notice sent whenever your password changes.
password_changed.heading: Your password changed
password_changed.intro: The password for {{ .Email }} was just changed. If it was you, there's nothing to do.
password_changed.note: Wasn't you? Reset your password from the sign-in screen and write to support as soon as possible.
